svg.title: RAWild: Toward Sensor-Agnostic RAW Object Detection via Physics-Guided Curve and Grid Modeling
svg.desc: Paper-and-ink title card. The RAWild wordmark and paper title sit on the left; the original project website RGB curves and three-dimensional grid sit on the right. Authors are listed separately in the README.
